observations.title: Failure to adequately investigate OOS discrepancies
observations.summary: The firm failed to thoroughly investigate unexplained discrepancies and out‑of‑specification results, did not identify root causes, implement appropriate CAPA, or expand investigations to affected batches.

observations.title: Failure to test component identity and purity
observations.summary: The firm failed to test each component for identity, purity, strength, and quality, and did not validate the reliability of component supplier testing, resulting in use of potentially contaminated ingredients.

observations.title: Inadequate production procedures and validation
observations.summary: The firm lacked adequate written procedures for production control and failed to validate manufacturing and cleaning processes, including revalidation after major changes and justification of carry‑over limits.

observations.title: Marketing of unapproved new drug products
observations.summary: Two OTC products were marketed as drugs containing active ingredients not permitted under the applicable monograph, making them unapproved new drugs in violation of sections 505(a) and 301(d) of the FD&C Act.

observations.title: Misbranding of OTC drug products
observations.summary: The two products are misbranded under section 502(ee) because they are nonprescription drugs that do not meet the applicable OTC monograph requirements, violating section 301(a) of the FD&C Act.
